meaning: n. 實用性；效用；公用事業

meaning:

meaning: adj. 明顯的；顯而易見的

meaning:

meaning:

meaning:

meaning:

meaning: adj. 實證的；以經驗為依據的

meaning:

meaning:

meaning: adj. 理性的；合理的；有理數的

meaning: n. 倫理；倫理學；道德規範

meaning: adv. 一貫地；持續穩定地

meaning: v. 支持；背書；代言；在背面簽名

meaning:

meaning:

meaning: n. 受託人；信託管理人

meaning: adj. 過度的；過量的；極端的

meaning: v. 區分；區別；使有差異

meaning:

meaning: n. 相關性；關聯；切題性

meaning: n. 讓步；特許權；優惠；（售貨）攤位

meaning: adj. 微小的；次要的；邊緣的

meaning: v. 制定；構想；用公式表示；清楚表達

meaning:

meaning: n. 謹慎；慎重；自行決定的自由；裁量權

meaning: n. 對齊；排列；結盟；一致

meaning:
adj. 破產的；資金枯竭的

meaning: n. 應得的權利；（福利）資格；自以為應得的心態

meaning: n. 差異；不一致；矛盾；出入

From a health standpoint, fried food should not be eaten every day. (從健康的觀點來看，油炸食物不該天天吃。)

meaning: v. 確認有效；證實；驗證

To maintain our global competitiveness, we must keep investing heavily in groundbreaking research and development. (為維持全球競爭力，我們必須持續大量投資於開創性的研究與開發。)

meaning: adv. 批判地；嚴重地；關鍵地

meaning:
n. 徵收；徵收額；稅款
v. 徵收；徵募；發動（戰爭等）

meaning: v. 逐步升高；加劇；使逐步升級

meaning: n. 撥款；（不當的）挪用、占用

meaning: adv. 適當地；正式地；如期地

Bonuses are proportional to annual performance ratings, ensuring that teams share rewards according to measurable results. (獎金依年度績效評等按比例發放，確保團隊依可衡量成果分享獎勵。)

meaning: vt. 承保；為……提供財務支持

meaning: vt. 支撐；構成⋯的基礎；加固

meaning: n. 支持者；倡導者；提議者

meaning:

meaning: n. 合作關係；隸屬關係

The report highlights the disparity in income between urban and rural households. (報告強調城鄉家庭之間的收入差距。)

meaning: adj. 階層的；等級制度的

meaning: n. 競爭者；有力候選者
example: The firm is a strong contender for the upcoming government contract due to its proven track record of project delivery. (該公司有可靠的專案交付紀錄，是即將招標的政府合約有力競爭者。)

meaning: n. 再投資；收益再投入；重新投資

meaning:

meaning: vt. 比⋯重要；勝過；重量超過

Every system has its own set of shortcomings that need addressing. (每個系統都有需要處理的缺點。)

meaning: adj. 有利可圖的；獲利豐厚的

meaning: n. 波動性；不穩定性；揮發性

The dramatic decline in local avian populations was directly attributable to intensive pesticide usage. (當地鳥類數量的劇烈下降，可直接歸因於密集的殺蟲劑使用。)

meaning:
adj. 非營利的

meaning: n. 顧問公司；顧問業務

meaning:
n. 障礙；欄架；跨欄賽
v. 跨越障礙；克服難關

meaning: adj. 系統性的；整體的；全身的

meaning: adj. 分析的；分析法的；善於分析的

meaning:
n. 閒置；鬆弛；淡季

The software engineering department rewrote the code to optimize application performance on mobile devices. (軟體工程部門重寫了程式碼，以最佳化應用程式在行動裝置上的效能。)
The European mercantile aristocracy constituted an exceptionally affluent elite tier, funding public planetariums and grand edifices. (歐洲的商業貴族階級構成了一個異常富裕的精英階層，資助了公共天文館與宏偉的大廈。)

meaning: adj. 附帶的；連帶的；旁系的

A small act of goodwill between neighbours can easily prevent bitter arguments that would otherwise last for years. (鄰居間一個小小的善意舉動，就能輕易避免原本可能持續多年的激烈爭吵。)

meaning:
vt. 支持；增強；支撐
n. 長枕；墊枕；支撐物

meaning: n. 棄權聲明；（費用、規定的）免除

A consortium of regional banks financed the renewable energy project after reviewing its long-term operating forecasts. (區域銀行組成的企業聯盟審查長期營運預測後，為再生能源專案提供融資。)
The global bank implemented a structural relief program to assist impoverished debtor nations during the recession. (全球銀行實施了一項結構性救濟計畫，以在經濟衰退期間協助貧困的債務國。)
The high sales volume is indicative of the successful marketing strategy implemented last quarter. (高銷售量顯示上季實施的行銷策略相當成功。)
The imposition of heavy agricultural taxes by the centralized state provoked intense unrest among ranchers. (中央集權國家強加沉重的農業稅，在牧場主之間引發了強烈的不安。)

meaning:
n. 禁運；貿易封鎖
vt. 對……實施禁運

Better utilization of rainwater could reduce the city's dependence on imported water. (更妥善利用雨水，可減少這座城市對進口水的依賴。)

meaning: vt. 精簡；使效率化；使流程更順暢

meaning: adj. 有說服力的；能令人信服的

DNA extraction tools underscore the complex genomic continuum linking early vertebrates. (DNA 萃取工具凸顯了連結早期脊椎動物的複雜基因體連續性。)
The department adopted incremental improvements to its reporting process instead of replacing every system at once. (該部門逐步改善報告流程，而非一次更換所有系統。)
Strong oceanic currents cause the water to churn violently near the rocky coastline. (強烈的洋流導致岩石海岸附近的海水劇烈翻滾。)
The organization's organizational bylaws explicitly stipulate that all guild members must register their handcraft specialty marks. (該組織的章程明確規定，所有公會成員都必須登記其手工藝專長標記。)

When two colleagues resigned, her workload nearly doubled. (兩位同事離職後，她的工作量幾乎增加了一倍。)

meaning: n. 財務援助；紓困；緊急救助

meaning:
n. 企業聯盟；財團；辛迪加

meaning:
adj. 最適宜的；最佳的
n. 最佳條件；最適值

The assessment measures each technician's competency in troubleshooting, equipment calibration, and customer communication. (評量會測量每位技術人員在故障排除、設備校準與客戶溝通方面的能力。)

meaning: n. 獨裁；專制政權；獨裁統治

Auditors will scrutinize every financial transaction to ensure absolute compliance. (稽核師將仔細審查每筆財務交易，以確保完全符合法規。)

meaning: adj. 無所不在的；普遍存在的

meaning:
n. 徹底檢修；全面改革；大修

meaning: adj. 合約的；契約規定的

meaning: n. 便利設施；生活設施

meaning: adj. 無處不在的；普遍的

meaning: adj. 微不足道的；不重要的；無意義的

This is only a provisional agreement. (這只是臨時協議。)

meaning: n. （抵押品）贖回權取消；法拍

meaning: adj. 可自行決定的；非必要的

meaning: n. 動力；推動力；促進因素

Destitute immigrant laborers filed a formal labor grievance, protesting the hazardous piecework conditions in industrial factories. (貧困的移民勞工正式提出勞工申訴，抗議工廠危險的計件工作條件。)

meaning: vt. 損害名譽；使不可信；駁斥

Effective persuasion techniques are essential for successful contract negotiations. (有效的說服技巧對於成功的合約談判至關重要。)

meaning:

n. 假設；公設；基本原理

The centralized state deployed elite garrison detachments to thwart private turnpike strikes instigated by outwork artisans. (中央集權國家派遣精銳衛戍部隊，阻止家庭代工工匠發起的民營收費公路罷工。)
There is an inconsistency between the financial report and our internal records that needs to be addressed. (財務報告與內部紀錄之間有不一致之處，需要處理。)

meaning:
n. 折讓；退款；回扣
vt. 退還部分款項；打折返還
example: Customers can claim a rebate if they purchase the product before the end of the month. (客戶若在月底前購買該產品，就可以申請折讓退款。)
The government plans to privatize the regional rail service while maintaining public oversight of passenger safety standards. (政府計畫將區域鐵路服務民營化，同時維持對乘客安全標準的公部門監督。)
Traditional art academies showed rigid aesthetic conservatism and rejected the impressionists' new approach. (傳統藝術學院展現僵化的審美保守主義，排斥印象派的新做法。)
The department will reorganize its team structure to improve workflow. (該部門將重組團隊架構，以改善工作流程。)
The two suppliers signed a pact to share emergency transportation capacity during severe regional shipping disruptions. (兩家供應商簽署協定，在區域運輸嚴重受阻時共享緊急運輸量能。)
Burning garden waste can easily aggravate local air pollution, particularly on still autumn days when smoke hangs low. (燃燒庭園廢棄物很容易加重當地空氣污染，尤其是在煙霧低垂的無風秋日。)

meaning: adj. 不相容的；合不來的
example: The rigid unchangeable art parameters of frontality were incompatible with the naturalistic transitions of Greek statuary. (僵化的正面性藝術原則，與希臘雕像的寫實風格轉變格格不入。)

meaning: adj. 權威的；可信的；專斷的
example: The report came from an authoritative source. (這份報告來自權威來源。)
The downside of living in a major city is the extremely high cost of living. (居住在大城市的大缺點就是極高的生活成本。)

meaning: n. 企業集團；綜合企業
example: The diversified conglomerate recently sold off its underperforming manufacturing division to focus on its core software business. (這家多元化的企業集團最近賣掉了績效不佳的製造部門，以專注於其核心軟體業務。)
Maintaining strict confidentiality regarding client data is the foundation of our reputation in the financial industry. (嚴格保護客戶資料的機密性，是我們在金融業建立聲譽的基礎。)

meaning:
adj. 威權的；專制的
n. 威權主義者
example: Under the authoritarian regime, newspapers could not criticize the leader. (在威權政權統治下，報紙不能批評領導人。)

meaning:
n. 推測；猜想
v. 推測；猜想

meaning:
v. 使超載；使負荷過重
n. 超載；過量

meaning: adj. 隨之而來的；因此發生的
example: Heavy rain caused flooding and the consequent closure of the main road. (大雨造成淹水，主要道路也因此封閉。)

meaning: adj. 中產階級的；資產階級的

The supplier's unilateral decision to raise prices angered its long-term clients. (供應商片面決定漲價，激怒了長期合作的客戶。)
The keynote speaker chose to allude to the ongoing geopolitical crisis without explicitly naming the countries. (主題發言人選擇暗指正在發生的地緣政治危機，而沒有明確點出國家的名字。)

meaning: adj. 有爭議的；好爭論的
example: Building a new airport runway remains a contentious issue for local residents. (興建新機場跑道對當地居民來說仍是極具爭議的問題。)
The new test needs independent validation before hospitals can use it. (這項新檢測在醫院使用之前，需要經過獨立驗證。)
The increased demand will necessitate hiring additional staff for the production line. (需求增加將使生產線必須增聘人員。)
Positive reinforcement at work can be far more effective than constant criticism. (職場中的正向強化，效果可能遠比不斷批評好。)

meaning: adj. 不可靠的；不可信的
example: Windmills represented an unreliable energy source for early industrial factories because regional airflow fluctuated constantly. (風車對早期的工業工廠來說代表了一種不可靠的能源，因為區域氣流經常波動。)
The lack of proper documentation could jeopardize the approval of your project proposal. (缺少適當文件，可能危及專案提案的核准。)

meaning: adj. 一致同意的；全體一致的
example: The jury finally reached a unanimous verdict, although the whole long trial had lasted almost three difficult weeks. (陪審團終於達成一致裁決，儘管這場漫長審判已持續將近三個艱難星期。)
Ageing populations bring societal challenges such as rising healthcare costs. (人口老化帶來醫療費用上升等社會挑戰。)
The company’s strong legal presence acts as a powerful deterrent against potential intellectual property theft. (公司強大的法務力量，對可能的智慧財產權竊取行為形成有力嚇阻。)
Developing a symbiotic mutualism with nitrogen-fixing bacteria is highly advantageous for legumes in poor soils. (與固氮細菌發展出共生的互利共生關係，對於貧瘠土壤中的豆科植物是非常有利的局勢。)
The behavioral study examined the powerful psychological mechanisms that drive social conformity in groups. (這項行為研究探討了驅使群體中社會遵從的強大心理機制。)

meaning: adj. 相關的；切題的；恰當的
example: The analyst provided pertinent data regarding consumer trends in the retail sector. (該分析師提供了有關零售業消費者趨勢的相關資料。)

meaning: vt. 歸因於；認為是…所致

The corporate downsizing resulted in a major layoff affecting fifty employees. (公司裁員導致大規模裁員，影響了 50 名員工。)
Rapid industrialization in the nineteenth century triggered a massive demographic shift from rural areas to cities. (十九世紀的快速工業化引發了人口從農村向城市的大規模轉移。)

meaning: n. 女性主義；女權主義
example: The novel explores feminism through three generations, showing how daily expectations gradually changed between mothers and their own daughters. (這本小說透過三代人探討女權主義，展現母親與女兒之間日常期待如何逐漸改變。)

meaning: adj. 至關重要的；首要的
example: Preserving the old-growth coniferous timberline sanctuary stands as a policy mission of paramount ecological seriousness. (保護古老原始的針葉林線保護區，是至關重要的生態政策目標。)

meaning:
n. 中間人；中介機構
adj. 中間的；媒介的
example: A trusted intermediary helped both companies negotiate delivery terms without revealing each party's confidential pricing strategy. (可信賴的中介協助兩家公司協商交貨條件，無須揭露雙方的機密定價策略。)
We have a reciprocal agreement with our partners to share resources. (我們與合作夥伴訂有共享資源的互惠協議。)
Hierarchical chiefdoms utilized ceremonial monuments to perpetuate the social dominance of aristocratic lineages. (階級化的酋邦利用儀式性紀念碑，來使貴族血統的社會主導地位永存。)

State governments set stringent rules to control the tolls charged on private turnpikes. (州政府訂下嚴格規定，管制民營收費公路的通行費。)
The village faces a perpetual threat of landslides, especially during the rainy season. (這個村莊一直面臨土石流威脅，雨季尤其如此。)
From the layers of ash, geologists deduced that the volcano had erupted twice. (地質學家從灰燼的層次推斷，這座火山曾經噴發兩次。)
Political protectionist tariff bills proposed by Whigs acted to polarize the state council along regional mercantile boundaries. (輝格黨提出的保護主義關稅法案，使議會依各地商業利益分化成兩派。)
Environmental scientists continue to grapple with the unpredictable ecological consequences driven by phosphorus agricultural runoff. (環境科學家持續努力處理農業磷逕流所造成的難以預測的生態後果。)
The economic slowdown has impacted our international sales. (經濟放緩影響了我們的國際銷售。)
Interest in the project began to wane after the delays. (延誤發生後，人們對這項專案的興趣開始減退。)
Local entrepreneurship grew after lenders offered small firms transparent terms and predictable repayment schedules. (放款機構提供透明條件和可預期的還款時程後，地方創業活動增加了。)

meaning: adj. 詐欺的；欺騙性的；虛假的
example: The bank froze accounts linked to fraudulent transactions while investigators reviewed the supporting documents. (調查人員審查佐證文件期間，銀行凍結了涉及詐欺交易的帳戶。)
The issuance of new shares requires shareholder approval under the company's articles of incorporation. (依公司章程，發行新股須經股東核准。)

meaning: adj. 可辨識的；可識別的
example: Each individual volcanic eruption leaves a chemically identifiable ash layer inside nearby sedimentary strata. (每次單獨的火山爆發，都會在附近的沉積地層內留下化學上可識別的火山灰層。)

meaning: adj. 微不足道的；可忽略的
example: The difference between the two prices was negligible, so she chose the nearer shop. (這兩種價格的差別微不足道，所以她選了較近的那家店。)

meaning: n. 強烈反彈；負面反應

meaning: n. 仲裁；公斷；仲裁程序

We need to recalculate the annual depreciation of our manufacturing equipment to reflect its current market value. (我們需要重新計算製造設備的年度折舊，以反映其當前市場價值。)
Constant background noise is detrimental to concentration, especially for students preparing for final exams. (持續的背景噪音有害專注力，準備期末考的學生尤其如此。)

meaning: n. 解除管制；放寬規範
example: Deregulation increased competition among energy suppliers but required stronger monitoring of consumer billing practices. (解除管制提高能源供應商之間的競爭，但也需要更嚴格監督消費者帳單作業。)

meaning: vt. 折算成年率；按年度計算

The revised compensation framework aims to achieve pay parity between employees performing equivalent work across regions. (修訂後的薪酬架構旨在讓各地從事同等工作的員工享有同等薪資。)

meaning:
n. 先決條件；前提
adj. 先決的；必要的
example: Basic statistics is a prerequisite for this course, so students without it must take an extra class first. (基礎統計是這門課的先決條件，因此沒學過的學生必須先修一門額外的課。)

meaning: n. 永續性；可持續發展；持續能力

The analyst compared the company's market capitalization with its annual revenue and total debt. (分析師比較公司的市值、年度營收與總負債。)
The consulting firm is conducting a feasibility study for the proposed resort development. (該諮詢公司正在對擬議的度假村開發進行可行性研究。)
Automation has changed factory work. (自動化改變了工廠工作。)
A shortfall in tax revenue prompted the city to postpone several planned infrastructure projects. (稅收不足促使市府延後數項原定的基礎建設計畫。)
The training investment had a clear payoff when employee errors dropped and customer satisfaction improved. (員工錯誤減少且客戶滿意度提升，顯示訓練投資帶來明確回報。)
The mediation process helped both parties reach an agreement without resorting to legal action. (調解程序協助雙方達成協議，無須訴諸法律行動。)

meaning:
vt. 使偏斜；使扭曲
adj. 歪斜的；偏斜的
example: Online surveys can easily skew results, because they mostly reach people with very strong opinions and reliable internet. (網路調查很容易使結果偏差，因為它們主要觸及意見強烈且網路穩定的人。)
The analyst added a caveat, noting that the survey excluded firms operating outside major cities. (分析師補充一項限制條件，指出調查未納入主要城市以外的企業。)

meaning: adv. 策略性地；有策略地
example: Our office is strategically located near the main train station. (我們的辦公室設在主要火車站附近，地點具有策略優勢。)

Executives tried to rationalize the closure, but workers questioned the promised savings. (主管試圖替關廠決定辯解，但員工質疑承諾的節省金額。)

Because of budgetary limits, the library will close on Sundays from next month. (由於預算限制，圖書館從下個月起週日將不開放。)

meaning: vt. 分散；分權；使去中心化

The standardization of shipping containers made global trade much cheaper. (貨櫃規格的標準化讓全球貿易成本大幅降低。)
The company will reimburse employees for all approved business travel expenses. (本公司將核銷員工所有經核准的商務差旅費用。)
Moderation in exercise is important at first, especially since suddenly doing too much can cause serious injury for beginners. (剛開始運動時適度很重要，尤其是突然做太多可能讓初學者嚴重受傷。)
Economic decline is a natural corollary of prolonged political instability. (經濟衰退是長期政治不穩定的必然結果。)
The manufacturer downsized its workforce after installing robots, although senior managers insisted no customer service would ever suffer. (這家製造商安裝機器人後裁減人力，儘管資深經理堅稱顧客服務絕不會受影響。)

meaning:
n. 反托拉斯法；競爭法
adj. 反托拉斯的；反壟斷的
example: The proposed merger requires antitrust review because both companies control significant shares of the same regional market. (由於兩家公司都掌握同一區域市場的顯著占比，合併提案必須接受競爭法審查。)
A sharp temperature gradient tracks the inflow of river water mixing within the estuary. (明顯的溫度梯度可追蹤流入河口並與海水混合的河水。)

meaning: adj. 勉強達標的；處於臨界點的

The court ruled that the confession was obtained through coercion and could not be used. (法院裁定這份自白是在脅迫下取得的，不得作為證據。)

meaning: n. 授權；賦能；增強自主權

The most common pitfall is to spend far too little time planning the project. (最常見的陷阱，就是花太少的時間規劃這項計畫。)

meaning: adj. 總體經濟的；宏觀經濟的

The claim that this software can solve all business problems is an exaggeration. (聲稱該軟體可以解決所有業務問題的說法有些誇張。)
The forensic audit provided conclusive evidence of embezzlement, leading to the immediate termination of the employee. (鑑識會計稽核提出挪用公款的確鑿證據，該員工因此立即遭到解雇。)
Before specialized labor division expanded, early Neolithic tribes practiced small-scale subsistence home gardening. (在專業分工擴大之前，新石器時代早期部落從事僅夠維生的家庭園藝。)

meaning:
vt. 使自由化；放寬限制；開放
vi. 走向自由化；放寬管制
example: The government plans to liberalize import rules to encourage competition among domestic retailers. (政府計畫放寬進口規定，鼓勵國內零售商之間的競爭。)
The festival and the harvest usually concur in the last week of September. (慶典和收成通常在九月最後一週同時發生。)
A central tenet of the theory is that social behavior changes through repeated interaction and shared expectations. (這項理論的核心原則是，社會行為會隨著反覆互動與共同期待而改變。)
The study found a propensity for younger participants to underestimate long-term environmental risks. (研究發現，年輕參與者傾向低估長期環境風險。)

meaning: vt. 誇大；言過其實；過度陳述
example: The spokesperson avoided overstating expected savings while explaining the company's new efficiency program. (發言人在說明公司新效率計畫時，避免誇大預期節省金額。)

meaning: n. 事後認知；事後眼光
example: In hindsight, executives underestimated how quickly online competitors could erode the chain's market share. (事後看來，主管低估了線上競爭者侵蝕連鎖品牌市占率的速度。)
Budget cuts can marginalize rural clinics even when officials claim that services remain equally available. (即使官員聲稱服務仍然普及，預算刪減仍可能讓鄉村診所被邊緣化。)

meaning: v. 取得；採購；設法獲得
example: The procurement department works hard to procure high-quality raw materials at low costs. (採購部門努力以低成本採購優質原料。)

meaning: n. 區隔；分割；細分市場
example: Customer segmentation helped the retailer tailor promotions to distinct groups of frequent shoppers. (顧客區隔協助零售商針對不同的常客群體量身設計促銷活動。)
Following liquidation, the administrator distributed remaining proceeds among creditors according to their legal priority. (清算後，管理人依照法定順位將剩餘款項分配給債權人。)
The legal team is monitoring for any potential intellectual property infringement by our competitors. (法務團隊正在監控競爭對手是否可能侵犯智慧財產權。)

meaning: adj. 不可否認的；確鑿的
example: It is an undeniable fact that the market is changing. (市場正在改變，這是不可否認的事實。)
The scientist firmly refuted the claim with evidence from three large independent studies published recently. (這位科學家以近期發表的三項大型獨立研究證據，堅決駁斥那項說法。)
The newspaper's ethos of independence depended on disclosing donors and correcting errors promptly. (報紙的獨立精神，有賴於公開捐助者並及時更正錯誤。)
The lender exploited a tax loophole that lawmakers had overlooked when approving the credit scheme. (放款機構利用立法者批准信貸方案時忽略的稅制漏洞。)

meaning: n. 專業素養；專業精神

The ideal judge must display complete disinterest in the financial outcomes of the corporate litigation. (理想的法官必須對這起公司訴訟的財務結果表現出完全的公正無私。)

meaning: adj. 伴隨的；同時發生的
example: Rapid industrialization inside the factory metropolis provoked a concomitant elevation in severe occupational health hazards. (工業大都市快速工業化的同時，也伴隨著嚴重職業健康危害的增加。)

meaning: vt. 低估；低價評估；不充分重視
example: The appraisal may undervalue the property if it ignores recent improvements to the building. (若鑑價忽略建築物近期改善，可能會低估該不動產的價值。)
Regional hegemony shifted when emerging economies began financing infrastructure beyond their borders. (新興經濟體開始資助境外基礎建設後，區域霸權也隨之轉移。)
The company was fined for misrepresenting projected savings in its investor presentation. (公司因在投資人簡報中歪曲預估節省金額而遭罰。)
Due to the budget cutback, the department had to cancel its annual holiday party. (由於預算削減，該部門不得不取消年度假日聚會。)
The insurer calculated the payout after reviewing repair receipts and confirming the policy's coverage limits. (保險公司檢視維修收據並確認保單保障上限後，計算了理賠金額。)

meaning: adj. 矛盾的；似非而是的
example: It was paradoxical that tighter restrictions coincided with a surge in informal cross-border trade. (嚴格管制之際，非正式跨境貿易反而激增，情況顯得矛盾。)
Logistical delays prevented medical teams from reaching isolated villages before the river flooded. (後勤延誤使醫療團隊未能在河水暴漲前抵達偏遠村落。)
High attrition among experienced nurses forced the hospital to postpone several planned service expansions. (資深護理師大量流失，迫使醫院延後數項原定的服務擴充。)
A rigorous scientist will immediately repudiate a hypothesis if empirical data contradicts its core predictions. (如果經驗資料與核心預測相矛盾，嚴謹的科學家會立即拒絕接受該假設。)
The panel assessed the reasonableness of the proposed rate increase against comparable regional services. (小組以區域內相近服務為基準，評估擬議調漲費率是否合理。)
Prosecutors alleged bribery after discovering payments routed through shell companies to secure the port contract. (檢察官發現款項透過人頭公司轉手以取得港口合約後，指控涉及賄賂。)

meaning: adj. 缺乏流動性的；難變現的
example: The fund's illiquid holdings prevented rapid withdrawals when market volatility triggered widespread investor concern. (市場波動引發投資人普遍憂慮時，基金的低流動性資產使它無法迅速應付提款。)

meaning: n. 教條；不容質疑的信條
example: The economist questioned the dogma that deregulation invariably produces fairer markets and greater prosperity. (這位經濟學家質疑去管制必然帶來更公平市場與繁榮的教條。)
The campaign sought to subvert public trust by circulating fabricated reports about the election process. (這場行動散布選務造假報告，企圖顛覆民眾對選舉程序的信任。)

meaning: adj. 明顯可感的；強烈的
example: A palpable tension filled the chamber as lawmakers prepared to vote on the unpopular pension bill. (立法者準備表決不受歡迎的年金法案時，議場瀰漫著明顯的緊張氣氛。)

meaning:
adj. 權宜的；方便的
n. 權宜之計；手段
example: The government opted for an expedient solution to lower inflation temporarily. (政府選擇了一種權宜之計來暫時降低通貨膨脹。)
The link between the two archaeological sites remains tenuous due to the lack of contemporary artifacts. (由於缺乏同時期的文物，這兩個考古遺址之間的關聯仍十分薄弱。)

meaning:
vt. 降級；降低評等；貶低
n. 降級；降等；降格
example: The agency may downgrade the bond rating if the company fails to reduce its debt this year. (若公司今年未能減債，評級機構可能會調降其債券評等。)
The agency released detailed cost estimates to buttress its argument for expanding the coastal rail network. (機關公布詳細成本估算，以支持擴建沿海鐵路網的主張。)
Nineteenth-century industrialization triggered rapid urbanization, drawing cheap unskilled labor into factory metropolis zones. (十九世紀工業化帶動快速都市化，吸引廉價非技術勞工前往工業都會區。)
The accounting team recorded the accrual of vacation expenses before closing the books for the current fiscal year. (會計團隊在結算本會計年度帳目之前，先記錄了休假費用的應計金額。)
Financial regulators implemented immediate safeguards to prevent a total systemic meltdown of the banking system. (金融監管機構實施了即刻的防範措施，以防止銀行系統發生完全的系統性崩潰。)

meaning: adj. 合理的；情有可原的
example: The company argued the price increase was justifiable because freight costs had doubled across three shipping routes. (公司主張調漲價格合理，因為三條航線的運費都已翻倍。)
It is difficult to extrapolate future trends based on such limited data. (很難根據如此有限的資料來推斷未來的趨勢。)
Counsel questioned the legality of the data transfer, noting that customers had never consented to foreign storage. (律師質疑資料移轉的合法性，指出客戶從未同意將資料存放在國外。)
Monumental stone pyramids and rigid frontality relief arts typify the cultural aesthetic of ancient Egyptian civilization. (宏偉的石造金字塔與僵硬的正面性浮雕藝術，作為古埃及文明文化美學的典型。)
To win neighborhood support, the developer recast the project as a public park with limited retail space. (為爭取社區支持，開發商把計畫重新塑造成附設少量零售空間的公園。)
As extruded basaltic lava flows cool under seawater, they quickly solidify into characteristic pillow formations. (噴出的玄武岩熔岩流在海水中冷卻後，會迅速凝固成特有的枕狀構造。)
Critics say the new law would legitimize a practice that harms consumers. (批評者表示，新法將使一種傷害消費者的做法合法化。)
The executive's defection to a rival firm exposed confidential pricing strategies and unsettled the board. (這名主管變節轉投競爭對手，曝光機密定價策略，也使董事會不安。)

meaning: n. 因果關係；因果作用
example: The study established correlation, not causation, so policymakers resisted claims that the subsidy created jobs. (研究證實的是相關性而非因果關係，因此政策制定者不接受補助創造就業的說法。)
The structural rigidity of the marine invertebrate's protective skeleton allows it to survive extreme tidal crashing wave zones. (海洋無脊椎動物堅硬的骨骼結構，使其能在潮汐巨浪猛烈衝擊的區域生存。)
An entrepreneurial land speculator bought vast midwest prairie hectares, anticipating the expansion of intercity railway networks. (一位具創業精神的土地投機者買下中西部廣大的草原土地，預期城際鐵路網將會擴建。)
A monthlong shutdown at the refinery cut fuel supplies and forced nearby manufacturers to reduce shifts. (煉油廠停工一個月，導致燃料供應減少，附近製造商也被迫縮減班次。)
Analysts surmise that the market index will experience a strong recovery next month. (分析師推測，下個月市場指數將出現強勁復甦。)
The normalization of trade ties reopened ports, though disputed fishing rights remained unresolved between both governments. (貿易關係正常化後，港口重新開放，但兩國仍未解決漁權爭議。)

meaning: adj. 極權的；極權主義的
example: The novel depicts a totalitarian state where surveillance reshapes private loyalties and public speech. (這部小說描寫一個極權國家，監控在其中重塑私人忠誠和公共言論。)
The foundation will disburse emergency grants once local clinics document staffing shortages and equipment costs. (地方診所記錄人力短缺和設備成本後，基金會就會撥付緊急補助。)

meaning: n. 極端主義；極端思想
example: The historian linked political extremism to unemployment, but cautioned that no single cause explained every uprising. (歷史學家將政治極端主義與失業連結起來，但提醒沒有單一原因能解釋所有起義。)
The newly introduced zoning regulations directly impinge on the traditional property rights of local landholders. (新推出的分區法規直接侵犯了當地地主的傳統財產權。)

meaning: n. 消費主義；消費文化
example: The essay questioned consumerism, arguing that endless upgrades had become a substitute for civic participation. (這篇文章質疑消費主義，認為無止盡升級商品已取代公民參與。)

meaning: n. 意外之財；意外收益
example: A windfall from the land sale enabled the cooperative to repair its aging cold-storage facility. (土地出售帶來的一筆意外收益，使合作社得以修繕老舊的冷藏設施。)

meaning: adj. 無關緊要的；有爭議的
example: The court deemed the challenge moot after the agency withdrew the rule and promised a revised review. (主管機關撤回規定並承諾重新審查後，法院認定這項挑戰已無實益。)
The goods were sent on consignment, meaning payment will only be made once they are sold to the final consumer. (這批貨物以寄售方式送出，也就是售予最終消費者後才會付款。)
The court awarded substantial compensatory damages to the victim to cover all medical expenses and lost wages. (法院判給受害者大筆補償性損害賠償金，以支付醫療費和工資損失。)

meaning:
adj. 精英主義的；排外的
n. 精英主義者；菁英分子
example: The board's elitist hiring culture favored familiar credentials over practical experience from regional offices. (董事會精英主義的聘用文化偏好熟悉的學歷背景，而不重視區域辦公室的實務經驗。)

meaning: n. 資產階級；中產階級
example: The novel portrays the bourgeoisie as divided between commercial ambition and fear of political upheaval. (小說將資產階級描寫為在商業野心和對政治動盪的恐懼之間分裂的一群人。)
The final report subsumed regional surveys into a national estimate, preserving local differences in a separate appendix. (最終報告將區域調查納入全國估算，並在附錄中保留各地差異。)
The report was based on spurious data, so we rejected it. (這份報告以不實資料為根據，因此我們拒絕採納。)

meaning: n. 基礎工作；準備工作
example: Years of groundwork by neighborhood groups made the waterfront cleanup possible after federal funds finally arrived. (聯邦資金終於到位後，社區團體多年來的準備工作讓海濱清理得以展開。)

meaning: vt. 使政治化；把…政治化
example: The mayor warned against politicizing the school board dispute, though her office had shaped the appointments. (市長警告不要將學區董事會爭議政治化，儘管人事任命受她的辦公室左右。)
Following the audit, lenders reassessed the company's prospects and extended credit only against verified orders. (稽核結束後，貸款機構重新評估公司的前景，只針對已確認的訂單提供信用。)
He used homework as a pretext to avoid the party. (他以作業為藉口不去派對。)
Decentralization gave county offices more authority, but uneven staffing produced different service standards. (分權讓郡辦公室獲得更多權力，但人力配置不均造成服務標準各異。)

meaning: adj. 無定論的；不確定的
example: The evidence was inconclusive, so the researchers continued their study. (證據尚無定論，因此研究人員繼續研究。)

meaning: n. 激進主義；激進思想
example: The scholar traced radicalism to a failed agrarian reform, not to the pamphlets authorities had blamed. (學者將激進主義的根源追溯至失敗的土地改革，而非當局指責的那些小冊子。)
The exhibit used juxtaposition to compare traditional paintings with digital art. (展覽運用並置手法，比較傳統畫作與數位藝術。)
The facilitator's guidance improved the facilitation of the group discussion. (引導者的指導促進了小組討論的進行。)
The salience of water access grew during negotiations, as farmers challenged the city's proposed industrial allocation. (談判期間，水資源取得的重要性日益凸顯，農民也反對市府提出的工業用水分配方案。)
After several revisions, the team found a workable solution to the problem. (經過幾次修訂後，團隊找到了解決問題的可行方案。)
Trust is the bedrock of any successful partnership. (信任是任何成功合作關係的根本基礎。)
The postponement of the port vote angered unions, whose members had already scheduled transport and childcare. (港口投票延期惹惱了工會，會員早已安排好交通和托育。)
A stalemate over pension contributions persisted until mediators separated guaranteed benefits from future cost increases. (退休金提撥問題陷入僵局，直到調解人將保障給付和未來成本增加分開討論才有進展。)
Construction came to a standstill when inspectors found unstable soil beneath the planned hospital wing. (檢查人員在規劃中的醫院側翼下方發現土壤不穩，工程因此停擺。)

meaning: adj. 有爭議的；值得商榷的
example: Whether the new policy will actually improve productivity is highly debatable. (新政策是否真的會提高生產力仍有很大爭議。)
Demand for reliable storage began to outstrip supply, prompting utilities to sign long contracts with battery makers. (可靠儲能的需求開始超過供應，促使公用事業公司和電池製造商簽訂長期合約。)

meaning: v. 重新定義；重新界定
example: The discovery may redefine how scientists understand the ancient species. (這項發現可能重新界定科學家對該古代物種的理解。)

meaning: adj. 物質主義的；重物質的
example: Critics say advertising constantly makes children materialistic, although parents can counter this by discussing needs and wants openly. (批評者說廣告不斷讓孩子變得物質主義，不過父母可以公開討論需求與欲望來抗衡。)

meaning: adj. 公正的；不偏不倚的
example: An external auditor was hired to provide an unbiased review of the accounts. (聘請了一名外部稽核師對帳目進行公正的審查。)
The repatriation of the sculpture followed a decade of negotiations between the museum and the source community. (博物館與原屬社群協商十年後，這座雕塑終於歸還原地。)
The report distinguished correlation from causality, noting that job growth followed the tax cut but did not prove its effect. (報告區分相關性和因果關係，指出減稅後就業增加，但這並不能證明減稅造成了增長。)
The government announced nationalization of the power grid after years of outages and failed private investment. (多年停電和民間投資失敗後，政府宣布將電網收歸國有。)

meaning:
n. 改革者；改革派人士
adj. 改革主義的；主張改革的
example: The reformist proposed changes to licensing rules that would make it easier for small firms to compete. (改革派人士提議修改執照規定，讓小型企業更容易參與競爭。)

meaning: adj. 交易型的；交易導向的
example: Their transactional relationship persisted only while both firms gained access to the other's distribution network. (雙方的交易型關係只在兩家公司都能使用對方的通路網路時才得以維持。)
The agreement is based on reciprocity: each nation grants the same rights to the other's citizens. (這項協議以互惠為基礎：兩國都給予對方公民相同權利。)
The governor moved to reassert authority over the ports after local councils began negotiating independent shipping fees. (地方議會開始自行協商航運費後，州長著手重申對港口的管轄權。)
The officials tried to coerce the witness into changing her testimony. (官員試圖脅迫證人改變證詞。)
The crux of the refinancing debate was whether the port's pension obligations had been properly disclosed. (再融資辯論的關鍵，在於港口的退休金義務是否已妥善揭露。)
The candidate refused to pander to wealthy donors, challenging their assumptions about tax incentives during the forum. (候選人拒絕迎合富有的捐助者，在論壇上挑戰他們對租稅優惠的看法。)
The school treats minor deviance, such as unpolished shoes, as a serious matter, which surprises many new pupils. (學校把鞋子沒擦亮這類輕微越軌行為當成嚴重問題，讓許多新生感到驚訝。)
The court may invalidate the contract if auditors prove that executives concealed the supplier's conflicts of interest. (若稽核人員證明高階主管隱瞞供應商的利益衝突，法院可能會判定合約無效。)

meaning: n. 交易對手；契約相對方
example: The bank verified the counterparty's identity before approving a foreign exchange transaction for the corporate client. (銀行在核准企業客戶的外匯交易前，查證了交易對手的身分。)
The curator chose to juxtapose factory ledgers with workers' letters, revealing competing accounts of the same strike. (策展人選擇將工廠帳冊和工人書信並置，呈現同一場罷工彼此競爭的敘事。)

meaning:
n. 替罪羊；代罪者
vt. 歸咎於；當替罪羊
example: Executives tried to scapegoat the junior auditor, but emails showed senior managers had approved the figures. (高階主管試圖把資淺稽核人員當替罪羊，但電子郵件顯示數字已獲資深主管核准。)
The initial outlay for the new manufacturing plant was quite substantial. (新製造廠的初期支出相當龐大。)
How to fund care for the growing elderly population remains a thorny political question. (如何為日益增加的老年人口提供照護經費，仍是棘手的政治問題。)

meaning: n. 股票經紀人；證券經紀人
example: The stockbroker reviewed the client's investment goals before recommending changes to the retirement portfolio. (股票經紀人在建議調整退休投資組合前，先檢視了客戶的投資目標。)
The governor described the uprising as an insurrection, while local historians emphasized years of contested land claims. (州長將這場起事稱為叛亂，地方歷史學家則強調多年來爭議不休的土地主張。)
Piecemeal repairs kept the bridge open for years but obscured the need for a complete structural replacement. (零碎的修繕讓橋梁多年維持通行，卻掩蓋了全面更換結構的必要性。)
Tourism remains the mainstay of the island's economy. (觀光業仍是該島經濟的支柱。)
A shortage of trained inspectors became the bottleneck, delaying permits for housing and clean-energy projects. (受過訓練的檢查員短缺成為瓶頸，延誤住宅和潔淨能源計畫的許可核發。)
The company exercised dominion over the valley's water rights until a court recognized longstanding tribal claims. (法院承認部族長期主張後，這家公司才失去對山谷水權的控制。)

meaning:
n. 傳統主義者；守舊派
adj. 傳統主義的；守舊的
example: A traditionalist in public life, the judge still supported reforms when evidence showed existing rules harmed tenants. (這位法官在公領域行事傳統，但證據顯示現行規定傷害房客時，她仍支持改革。)

meaning: n. 權力下放；移交權力
example: Devolution shifted budget authority to the provinces, exposing sharp differences in how clinics were funded. (權力下放將預算決定權移交各省，也暴露出診所經費來源的明顯差異。)
If freight costs skyrocket again, our pricing strategy will need immediate adjustment. (如果貨運成本再次暴漲，我們就必須立即調整定價策略。)
The centralization of budgets gave the headquarters more control over spending. (預算集中化讓總部更能掌控支出。)

meaning: adj. 通貨膨脹的；助長物價上漲的
example: Inflationary pressures forced the manufacturer to renegotiate supplier contracts before setting prices for the next season. (通膨壓力迫使製造商在訂定下季價格前，重新協商供應商合約。)

meaning: n. 管理不善；經營失當
example: Years of mismanagement left the pension fund unable to meet promised payments without additional public support. (多年管理不善，使退休基金若沒有額外公帑支援就無法支付承諾的給付。)
The board voted to rescind the contract after auditors uncovered undisclosed payments to a supplier's consultant. (稽核人員發現有未揭露款項付給供應商顧問後，董事會表決撤銷合約。)

meaning: v. 放氣；使洩氣；使受挫
example: Workers had to deflate the large inflatable promotional balloon before the storm arrived. (暴風雨來臨前，工人必須為大型促銷氣球放氣。)
In the early stages of the startup ecosystem, companies would often barter their services to conserve cash flow. (在新創生態系發展初期，公司常以服務交換來維持現金流。)

meaning: adj. 可互換的；可交替使用的
example: The internal components of the two computer models are completely interchangeable. (兩種電腦型號的內部組件完全可以互換。)

meaning: n. 黨派偏見；黨派支持
example: Partisanship delayed the commission's report, as members disputed whether its findings might influence the mayoral race. (委員會成員爭論調查結果是否會影響市長選舉，黨派偏見因此延誤了報告。)

meaning: n. 實用主義；務實作風

meaning: adj. 不擇手段的；無道德顧忌的

meaning: adj. 民族主義的；國族主義的

meaning: adj. 無定形的；不成形的

The massive preponderance of specialized angiosperm plants inside modern equatorial zones began during late Cretaceous adaptive radiations. (赤道地區被子植物的大量增加，始於白堊紀晚期的適應輻射。)

meaning: vt. 證明無罪；免除責任

The onus now falls on regulators to explain why repeated warnings failed to prevent the chemical leak. (現在監管機關有責任說明，為何多次警告仍未能阻止化學品外洩。)

meaning: adj. 不受影響的；不能穿透的

meaning: adj. 無擔保的；未固定的；不安全的

meaning: n. 人口過剩；人口過多

Profit maximization cannot be the sole objective when management evaluates safety, customer trust, and long-term stability. (管理階層評估安全、客戶信任與長期穩定時，利潤最大化不能是唯一目標。)
The hearings covered the full gamut of concerns, from privacy risks to unequal access to services. (聽證會涵蓋各種疑慮，從隱私風險到服務取得不平等都有討論。)
The board emphasized that while we have achieved good results, we must avoid any unnecessary extravagance. (董事會強調，雖然我們已取得良好成果，仍必須避免不必要的揮霍。)

meaning: adj. 赤貧的；一無所有的

We firmly guarantee that your initial starting salary will be directly commensurate with your extensive professional experience and unique skill set. (我們保證您的起薪會與豐富的專業經驗和獨特技能完全相稱。)

meaning: adj. 無庸置疑的；無爭議的

Prosecutors accused the broker of conspiring to defraud pension funds through inflated valuations. (檢察官指控這名經紀人合謀透過灌高估值詐騙退休基金。)

Reunification remained distant as leaders disagreed over borders, citizenship, and control of public assets. (領袖對邊界、公民身分與公共資產控制權意見不一，重新統一仍遙不可及。)

meaning: adj. 極惡劣的；明顯錯誤的

The structural incompatibility monitored between loose granular till and dense crystalline basalt bedrocks complicated roadbed building. (在鬆散顆粒狀冰磧與緻密結晶玄武岩基岩之間監測到的結構不相容性，使路基建設複雜化。)
A glut of imported steel pushed prices down, threatening domestic mills already operating below capacity. (進口鋼材供過於求，壓低價格，也威脅到產能未滿的本土鋼廠。)

The isolated landlocked hyper-saline marine lake functions as a perfect dynamic biological microcosm for research. (這座與外界隔絕的內陸高鹽度湖泊，是理想的研究用生物縮影。)

meaning: adj. 無效的；不起作用的

meaning: n. 免受懲罰；逍遙法外

meaning: n. 知識界；知識分子群體

meaning: n. 務實主義者；實用主義者

meaning:

meaning: n. 嚴重性；重大；滔天罪行

meaning: adj. 站不住腳的；難以維持的

meaning: adj. 未受管制的；無監管的

meaning: adj. 無利可圖的；不賺錢的

meaning: adj. 未受質疑的；無人挑戰的

The scientist's rebuttal addressed each allegation with data from independent laboratories and field surveys. (這位科學家以獨立實驗室與實地調查的資料，逐一反駁每項指控。)

meaning: adj. 不溶的；無法解決的

meaning: n. 公民群體；全體市民

meaning: adj. 未成功的；半途而廢的

The company continued to flout emissions limits even after regulators imposed substantial penalties. (即使主管機關已處以重罰，該公司仍持續公然違反排放上限。)

meaning: n. 廢除種族隔離；解除隔離
example: Desegregation advanced unevenly as local governments resisted court orders and delayed school integration. (地方政府抗拒法院命令並拖延校園融合，使廢除種族隔離的進展不均。)

meaning: n. 生質燃料；生物燃料
example: The refinery expanded biofuel production, though analysts questioned whether feedstock supplies could keep pace. (煉油廠擴大生質燃料產量，但分析師質疑原料供應能否跟上。)

meaning: n. 重新調整；重新結盟

meaning: adj. 煽動性的；縱火的；燃燒的

meaning: n. 底層階級；弱勢階層

meaning: adj. 不喜歡的；反感的；厭惡的

meaning: n. 民粹主義；民粹政治

meaning: adj. 不可撤銷的；無法挽回的

meaning: adj. 高昂的；過高的；禁止的

meaning: n. 證明正確；洗清罪名

meaning: adj. 一針見血的；敏銳的

The sequential movement created by cinema projectors provides an illusory impression of smooth physical motion to the audience. (電影放映機呈現連續的影像，使觀眾產生流暢動作的錯覺。)

meaning: adj. 簡潔的；簡短生硬的

The mediator helped the town extricate itself from a lawsuit by negotiating a monitored cleanup schedule. (調解人協商出受監督的清理時程，協助鎮公所脫離訴訟。)

meaning: vt. 以…作抵押；提供擔保
example: The lender required the founder to collateralize the new loan with equipment and shares in the subsidiary. (貸款機構要求創辦人以設備和子公司股份作為新貸款的抵押品。)

meaning: n. 全體一致、一致同意
example: The board of directors achieved complete unanimity regarding the selection of the new chief executive. (董事會在新任執行長人選上達成完全一致。)

meaning: adj. 無法克服的、難以逾越的
example: The deep ocean trench presented what initially seemed like insurmountable technical obstacles for exploration teams. (深邃的海溝最初對探測隊來說，呈現出看似無法克服的技術障礙。)
The court ordered the company to desist from contacting former employees about their pending compensation claims. (法院命令公司停止聯絡前員工，避免對方談論尚未處理的薪資補償請求。)
An undercurrent of distrust persisted in the talks, despite public statements celebrating a breakthrough. (儘管公開聲明宣稱談判已有突破，會談中仍瀰漫著不信任的暗流。)
A precipitous drop in enrollment forced the institute to merge departments and sell two unused properties. (招生人數急遽下滑，迫使研究機構合併部門並出售兩處閒置資產。)
Changing social mores reshaped the debate over who could inherit property and control family businesses. (社會習俗改變後，關於誰能繼承財產並掌控家族企業的辯論也隨之轉變。)

meaning: n. 相互關係；相互影響
example: Ecologists analyze the complex interrelationship between predatory finches and localized angiosperm seed production. (生態學家分析捕食性雀鳥與局部被子植物種子產量之間複雜的相互關係。)
The lobbyist tried to cajole council members into approving the deal before its costs became public. (遊說者試圖在成本公開前哄誘議員批准這項交易。)
The hearing exposed the falsity of claims that the hospital had consulted patients before closing the ward. (聽證會揭穿了醫院聲稱關閉病房前曾諮詢病患的說法。)
The tradeoff was clear: faster permitting would attract investment but reduce time for public review. (取捨很明顯：加快核發許可能吸引投資，卻會縮短公眾審查時間。)
The proposal met derision from local officials, who found its cost estimates detached from regional realities. (地方官員嘲笑這項提案，認為其中的成本估算脫離區域實際狀況。)

meaning: adj. 錯綜的；複雜難懂的
example: A convoluted ownership structure concealed the shell companies receiving payments from the public infrastructure contract. (錯綜複雜的所有權結構，掩蓋了從公共建設合約收款的空殼公司。)
Automation was no panacea for the factory's losses, since weak demand and expensive credit remained unresolved. (自動化不是解決工廠虧損的萬靈丹，因為需求疲弱和融資昂貴的問題仍未解決。)
Buying directly from the farmers eliminates the cost of the middleman. (直接向農民購買可以省去中間人的成本。)
Her exceptional business acumen allowed her to expand the family-owned grocery store into a retail empire. (她卓越的商業敏銳度使她能夠將家族經營的雜貨店擴大為一個零售帝國。)
The gradual accretion of fees made the supposedly affordable loan far more expensive than advertised. (費用逐漸累積，使這筆號稱負擔得起的貸款比廣告宣稱昂貴得多。)
Extrinsic motivation, such as money, is not always effective for long-term retention. (外在動機（例如金錢）對長期維持學習成效並不總是有效。)
The acquirer promised to retain the regional newsroom and honor existing labor agreements after the purchase. (收購方承諾收購後保留地方新聞編輯部，並遵守現有勞資協議。)
The auditor used dated invoices to rebut the claim that the disputed payments had been authorized. (稽核人員用有日期的發票反駁爭議款項已獲授權的說法。)
The historian traced republicanism in the constitution to debates over limiting executive power. (歷史學家將憲法中的共和主義思想追溯到限制行政權力的辯論。)
The newspaper corrected the falsehood promptly, but the fabricated accusation had already spread across social media. (報社迅速更正了這項謊言，但捏造的指控早已在社群媒體上傳開。)
Investigators questioned the plausibility of the timeline because two witnesses placed the vehicle elsewhere that evening. (兩名證人當晚都指稱車輛在別處，調查人員因此質疑時間線的可信度。)
A nonpartisan commission will review district boundaries and publish its methods before recommending any changes. (無黨派委員會將審查選區邊界，並在提出任何變更前公布其方法。)
The mayor was loath to approve another rent increase while residents were still waiting for promised repairs. (居民仍在等待承諾的修繕時，市長不情願再批准一次租金調漲。)
Negotiations collapsed into recrimination, with both sides accusing the other of leaking confidential drafts. (談判演變成互相指責，雙方都指控對方洩漏機密草案。)
The treaty established a clear demarcation between fishing zones, reducing disputes among neighboring coastal communities. (條約明確劃分了漁區界線，減少鄰近沿海社區之間的爭端。)

meaning: adj. 無情的；不可阻擋的
example: The inexorable rise in insurance costs forced several rural clinics to shorten hours and postpone equipment upgrades. (保險費無情上漲，迫使數間鄉村診所縮短營業時間並延後設備升級。)
The lifestyle of the late empire was seen as overly decadent. (帝國晚期的生活方式被認為是過度頹廢的。)

meaning: adj. 無力償債的；破產的
example: Without a significant infusion of capital, the company risks becoming insolvent by the end of the year. (若沒有大量資金挹注，公司可能在年底前無力償債。)
The official apologized for derogatory remarks about migrant workers and met with community representatives the following day. (官員為貶低移工的言論道歉，並於隔天與社區代表會面。)
It seemed disingenuous for the company to praise transparency while refusing to disclose its lobbying expenses. (公司拒絕公開遊說支出，卻大談透明，這顯得不坦率。)

meaning: v. 默許；默認；勉強同意
example: The director decided to acquiesce to the committee's recommendations. (主管決定默許委員會的建議。)
The new surveillance policy may contravene privacy protections written into the state constitution. (新的監控政策可能違反州憲法明文保障的隱私權。)
Interviews challenged the preconception that older residents opposed every change to the downtown district. (訪談打破了年長居民反對市中心所有改變的成見。)
The contract includes a clause for the eventuality that severe flooding interrupts deliveries for more than a week. (合約列有條款，因應嚴重洪水導致配送中斷超過一週的可能情況。)
The high unpredictability of global atmospheric weather trends makes long-term crop yield forecasting inherently speculative. (全球大氣與天氣趨勢高度難以預測，使長期作物產量預測本質上帶有推測性。)

meaning: adj. 可爭辯的；有理由的
example: It is arguable that the merger improved service, although customers still face longer waits at regional offices. (雖然客戶在區域辦公室仍得等更久，但合併確實改善服務這點仍可爭辯。)
Rapid software obsolescence forced the hospital to replace diagnostic systems before their expected service life ended. (軟體快速過時，迫使醫院在診斷系統預期使用年限屆滿前更換設備。)
The monarch agreed to abdicate after parliament negotiated a peaceful transfer of authority with opposition leaders. (國會與反對派領袖協商和平移交權力後，君主同意退位。)

meaning: adj. 無可爭辯的；明確的
example: The archive provides indisputable evidence that officials received the complaint months before the public inquiry. (檔案提供無可爭辯的證據，證明官員早在公開調查數月前就收到投訴。)

meaning: adj. 難以持續的；不可持續的
example: Rising rents made the nonprofit current budget unsustainable, so its directors began seeking long-term funding. (租金上漲使非營利組織目前的預算難以持續，因此董事開始尋找長期資金。)

meaning: adj. 令人難信的；不可信的
example: The minister offered an unconvincing explanation for why the procurement records disappeared before the audit. (部長對採購紀錄為何在稽核前消失提出的解釋令人難以信服。)
Standardized reporting improved comparability between hospitals, allowing regulators to identify unusual billing patterns. (標準化報告提升了各醫院間的可比性，讓監管機關得以找出異常帳務模式。)

meaning:
vi. 貶值；折舊
vt. 使貶值；折舊
example: Company vehicles depreciate over time, so the accounting department updates their book values every fiscal year. (公司車輛會隨時間折舊，因此會計部每個會計年度都更新其帳面價值。)
Reducing the safety team would do a disservice to employees who already face unpredictable conditions at the plant. (縮編安全團隊會傷害那些已在工廠面對不可預測狀況的員工。)
The court questioned the proportionality of imposing a lifetime ban for a minor first-time reporting violation. (法院質疑，對初犯且情節輕微的申報違規施以終身禁令是否相稱。)
After reviewing the source documents, the magazine issued a retraction and apologized to the wrongly accused official. (檢視來源文件後，雜誌刊登撤回聲明，並向遭錯誤指控的官員道歉。)
The deferral of the tax increase gave small businesses another year to adjust their budgets and staffing. (稅額調升延期，讓小型企業多了一年調整預算與人力。)
The court moved to nullify the permit after finding that officials had concealed safety violations. (法院發現官員隱瞞安全違規後，著手撤銷許可。)
The study explored the duality of a port that was both a commercial hub and a military outpost. (研究探討港口的雙重性：它既是商業樞紐，也是軍事前哨。)

meaning: n. 第三方保管；託管款項
example: The buyer placed the disputed payment in escrow until the contractor repaired the defective roof. (買方將有爭議的款項交由第三方保管，直到承包商修好瑕疵屋頂。)
The columnist insinuated that the agency favored donors, though he offered no documentary evidence. (專欄作家暗示機關偏袒捐款者，卻沒有提出任何文件證據。)
The company’s repair costs rose threefold after regulators required stronger materials for coastal equipment. (主管機關要求沿海設備使用更堅固材料後，公司的維修成本增至三倍。)
The director belittled junior staff in public, prompting several experienced analysts to resign. (主管公開貶低資淺員工，導致幾位資深分析師辭職。)
The legalization of the trade changed how firms disclosed payments to overseas agents. (這項貿易合法化，改變了企業揭露付給海外代理商款項的方式。)
The belligerent minister threatened retaliation before mediators could present their proposal to both delegations. (調停人還沒向雙方代表團提出方案，好戰的部長便威脅要報復。)
The investigation managed to absolve the pilot from any blame. (調查免除了飛行員的所有責任。)
The treaty established rules for coexistence between fishing fleets from the neighboring countries. (這項條約訂定鄰國漁船之間共存的規則。)

meaning: n. 錯誤資訊；不實訊息
example: Misinformation spread quickly after officials released conflicting statements about the chemical spill. (官員對化學物質外洩發布互相矛盾的說法後，錯誤資訊迅速擴散。)

meaning: adj. 曲折的；複雜難懂的
example: The company’s tortuous ownership structure made it difficult to identify the true beneficiaries. (公司曲折複雜的所有權結構，使人難以找出真正受益者。)
The contract includes one legal nicety that determines when suppliers may demand final payment. (合約有一項法律細節，攸關供應商何時能要求最後付款。)
The investor’s disengagement from the project forced the consortium to seek new financing. (投資人退出計畫後，企業聯盟被迫尋求新的資金。)
The judge excluded extraneous testimony that distracted jurors from the central evidence. (法官排除無關證詞，以免陪審員被帶離核心證據。)
The professor's lengthy digression about his personal vacation confused students during the physics lecture. (在物理課上，教授關於他個人度假的冗長離題讓學生們感到困惑。)
At the zenith of its influence, the union represented nearly every dockworker along the coast. (在影響力的頂峰，這個工會代表了沿岸幾乎所有碼頭工人。)
Economists observed a gradual diminution of consumer spending following the implementation of the sales tax. (經濟學家觀察到，在實施營業稅後，消費者支出逐漸減少。)
Several directors demurred when the chair proposed selling the company’s most profitable division. (主席提議出售公司獲利最高的部門時，有幾位董事表示反對。)
The agency delayed disbursement until contractors submitted receipts for every emergency purchase. (承包商提交每筆緊急採購的收據後，機關才發放款項。)

meaning: adj. 腐蝕性的、侵蝕性的
example: Industrial wastewater often contains highly corrosive chemical agents that degrade concrete drainage systems. (工業廢水通常含有高度腐蝕性的化學物質，會侵蝕混凝土排水系統。)

meaning: adj. 二分的；截然對立的
example: The report rejected a dichotomous account that portrayed rural voters as uniformly hostile to reform. (報告否定了二分法的說法，指出鄉村選民並非一律反對改革。)

meaning: adj. 社會文化的；社會與文化相關的
example: The sociocultural study linked changing family structures to migration and industrial employment. (這項社會文化研究將家庭結構變化，連結到移民與工業就業。)
The high thermal fluidity of subsurface molten magma dictates the eruption velocity of active basaltic volcanic fault lines. (地表下熔融岩漿的高熱流動性，決定了活躍玄武岩火山裂隙的噴發速度。)
A rare concord between labor and management allowed the plant to reopen safely. (勞資雙方難得達成一致，讓工廠得以安全重新開工。)
The analyst questioned the relatedness of the proposed benchmark to the firm’s actual market. (分析師質疑這項基準與公司實際市場的關聯性。)
The agency released the test results to assuage public fears about the nearby chemical plant. (機關公布檢測結果，以緩和民眾對附近化學工廠的恐懼。)

meaning: adj. 未開發的；未利用的
example: Geologists believe that the remote Arctic region contains vast, untapped reserves of natural gas. (地質學家認為，偏遠的北極地區含有大量未開發的天然氣儲量。)

meaning: n. 償付能力；償債能力
example: Regulators questioned the insurer’s solvency after its largest clients withdrew their policies. (最大客戶撤回保單後，主管機關開始質疑這家保險公司的償付能力。)
An adversarial review process exposed weaknesses that the agency’s internal team had overlooked. (對抗式審查揭露了機關內部團隊忽略的缺失。)

meaning: adj. 固執的；頑固的；難以去除的
example: The obstinate child refused to listen. (那個固執的孩子拒絕聽話。)

meaning: n. 機會主義；見風轉舵
example: Critics viewed the sudden policy reversal as opportunism rather than a genuine response to evidence. (批評者認為，這次突然轉向是機會主義，而非真正根據證據調整政策。)
The review found a clear contravention of privacy rules in the firm’s customer tracking system. (審查發現這家公司的客戶追蹤系統明顯違反隱私規範。)
The chair berated the contractor for ignoring repeated warnings about structural weaknesses. (主席痛斥承包商無視多次提出的結構缺陷警告。)
Internationalization helped the manufacturer diversify its markets after domestic demand weakened during the downturn. (國際化協助製造商在經濟衰退、國內需求疲弱後拓展多元市場。)

meaning: adj. 多元的；多元主義的
example: A pluralistic council reserved seats for cultural groups that had long been excluded from city decisions. (多元的議會為長期被排除於市政決策之外的文化團體保留席次。)
The brand’s distinctiveness came from durable products rather than an expensive advertising campaign. (這個品牌的獨特性來自耐用產品，而非昂貴的廣告活動。)
The ministry agreed to defray transport costs for witnesses traveling from remote districts. (部會同意支付從偏遠地區前來作證者的交通費。)

meaning: adj. 無關緊要的；不重要的
example: The oversight seemed inconsequential until auditors found that it altered the final payment calculation. (這項疏漏原本看似無關緊要，直到稽核人員發現它改變了最終付款金額。)
Counsel adduced shipping logs to show that the disputed cargo had reached the harbor. (律師提出航運紀錄，證明有爭議的貨物曾運抵港口。)
As a precautionary measure, the coastal city evacuated low-lying residential neighborhoods before the hurricane made landfall. (作為預防措施，這座沿海城市在颶風登陸前撤離了低窪住宅區。)

meaning: adj. 違反直覺的；反常理的
example: The counterintuitive finding showed that reducing traffic lanes improved average travel times. (這項違反直覺的發現顯示，減少車道反而改善了平均行車時間。)
The mechanization of threshing operations during the Industrial Revolution slashed agricultural labor demands extensively. (工業革命期間，打穀作業的機械化大幅減少了農業勞動力需求。)
Analysts warned that investors might overvalue the startup’s patents before its first commercial release. (分析師警告，投資人可能在新創公司首次商業上市前就高估其專利價值。)
The agreement emphasized minimization of waste throughout the company’s supply chain and logistics network. (協議強調應在公司供應鏈與物流網路各環節盡量減少浪費。)
The non-profit organization launched a program to combat adult illiteracy in the area. (該非營利組織發起了一項旨在消除該地區成人文盲的計畫。)
An undertone of resentment persisted beneath the executives’ carefully rehearsed statements during the negotiations. (主管們字斟句酌的發言底下，在談判期間仍暗藏著怨懟情緒。)
The commission’s impartiality was questioned after its chair accepted gifts from a bidder. (委員會主席收受投標者禮物後，委員會的公正性受到質疑。)

meaning: adj. 家長式作風的；專斷保護的
example: The paternalistic policy offered services to poor families while excluding them from planning decisions. (這項家長式政策為貧困家庭提供服務，卻排除他們參與規劃決策。)
The revised accounts evince a pattern of delayed payments to smaller subcontractors. (修訂後的帳目顯示，公司一再延遲支付較小型分包商款項。)
The anatomical blubber insulating layer protects the Arctic pinniped from the freezing harshness of polar waters. (皮下脂肪隔熱層能保護北極鰭足類，避免牠們受極地水域的嚴寒侵襲。)

meaning: adj. 不可化約的；不可削減的
example: Even after negotiations, the union insisted that safe staffing levels were an irreducible requirement. (即使經過協商，工會仍堅持安全人力配置是不可削減的要求。)
Conflicting safety standards stymied the cross-border rail project for nearly a decade. (互相衝突的安全標準，讓跨境鐵路計畫受阻近十年。)

meaning: n. 計算錯誤；判斷失誤
example: A miscalculation in projected demand left the utility with costly surplus electricity. (需求預測的計算錯誤，使公用事業公司留下昂貴的電力過剩。)
The watchdog castigated the firm for repeatedly ignoring warnings about its unsafe chemical storage. (監督團體痛批這家公司一再忽視化學品儲存不安全的警告。)

meaning: vi. 表現不佳；未達預期
example: The division continued to underperform after management replaced its sales strategy twice. (管理層兩度更換銷售策略後，這個部門仍持續表現不佳。)
Supporters reviled the journalist after she published evidence of undeclared campaign donations. (記者公布未申報競選捐款的證據後，支持者對她大肆辱罵。)
The inquiry uncovered a machination to steer public contracts toward companies owned by relatives. (調查揭露一項陰謀，企圖將公共合約導向官員親屬持有的公司。)

meaning: adj. 誇大的；過分渲染的
example: The report described the market panic as overblown, citing stable employment and household savings. (報告援引穩定的就業與家庭儲蓄，認為市場恐慌被過度渲染。)

meaning: n. 過度概括；以偏概全
example: The consultant’s overgeneralization treated several distinct regional markets as one uniform customer base. (顧問以偏概全，把數個不同的區域市場都當成同一種客群。)
Despite his protestations of innocence, investigators found his signature on the transfer authorization. (儘管他堅稱自己無辜，調查人員仍在轉帳授權書上找到他的簽名。)

meaning: adj. 膚淺的；過於簡單的
example: The review rejected a facile explanation that blamed inflation solely on workers’ wage demands. (評論否定了膚淺的說法，認為不能把通膨全怪在勞工要求加薪上。)

meaning: adj. 好爭辯的；愛爭論的
example: His highly argumentative demeanor during the negotiation process alienated several potential business partners. (他在談判過程中好爭辯的態度，使幾位潛在商業夥伴疏遠了他。)

meaning: adj. 不精確的；不準確的
example: Using imprecise measurements in chemical experiments can lead to completely inaccurate and dangerous results. (在化學實驗中使用不精確的測量，可能導致錯誤且危險的結果。)

meaning: n. 無能力；失去行為能力
example: The board invoked the chief executive's incapacity clause after medical leave became indefinite. (執行長因病假期限未定，董事會援引其失能條款。)
